PMF.binaryMixture: For 0 ≤ t ≤ 1, the binary mixture draws from p with probability t and from q with probability 1 − t.
PMF.binaryMixture_apply: For each outcome a and 0 ≤ t ≤ 1, the binary mixture assigns mass t p(a) + (1 − t) q(a).
PMF.binaryMixture_zero: The binary mixture of p and q with weight zero on p equals q.
PMF.binaryMixture_one: The binary mixture of p and q with weight one on p equals p.
